name: appsec-workflow
description: Use AI reasoning to find vulnerabilities and create project-specific rules and dependency models for whole-program static taint analysis

interface.shortDescription: Find vulnerabilities with AI reasoning and static taint analysis
interface.longDescription: Use an AI agent to learn the application's trust boundaries and vulnerability patterns. The agent writes taint rules and dependency models for this context. OpenTaint runs whole-program static taint analysis with these rules and models. OpenTaint uses the same rules and models in future scans.
defaultPrompt: Use the appsec-agent skill to run a deep scan with static triage
Use the appsec-agent skill to run a normal scan with static triage
Use the appsec-agent skill to run a lite scan with dynamic confirmation
